# Macrion 0.3.0

Macrion 0.3 is a major refinement release. The app's interface has been comprehensively modernized with Material Design 3 and Material You while keeping the familiar scenario automation feature set intact.

## A refreshed, more consistent interface

- Reworked the scenario list, settings, scenario editor, action and condition editors, overlays, dialogs, tutorials, and debugging screens with a modern Compose-based interface.
- Improved light and dark theme colors, contrast, layout fidelity, keyboard behavior, and rotation-state handling throughout the app.
- Refined scenario switching and navigation, including clearer back and home behavior and an optional confirmation before stopping a running scenario.

## Reliability and privacy

- Replaced Crashlytics with Macrion's own opt-in crash reporting flow. Crash reports are stored locally, redacted before upload, and provide clearer diagnostic context.
- Improved scenario, backup, and database migration compatibility, including localized backup messages and repairs for affected scenario data.
- Fixed crashes and edge cases in scenario resolution controls, editor dialogs, tutorial screens, Locale plug-ins, and recorder bitmap handling.

## Other improvements

- Added direct Discord, GitHub, and bug-report links in the app.
- Updated Locale plug-in icons and configuration screens.
- Expanded automated coverage for translations, backups, migrations, crash reports, and editor behavior.

## Installation

Download the APK matching your device. `arm64-v8a` is the usual choice for modern Android phones; use the universal APK if you are unsure.

Back up important scenarios before upgrading. Macrion is based on [Klick'r / Smart AutoClicker](https://github.com/Nain57/Smart-AutoClicker), and the existing Klick'r 4.0.1 feature set remains available.
